Rumor has it that Apple will use "iPhone Ultra" as the brand name for its upcoming foldable model, and Mark Gurman says this is indeed the name widely used internally within the company.

"iPhone Ultra" foldable phone name is reportedly in use inside Apple

Apple is set to unveil its long-awaited foldable iPhone at its September event next month.

Since rumors of the first foldable iPhone began circulating, the device has generally been referred to as the "iPhone Fold".

However, earlier this year, leakers began claiming that "iPhone Ultra" would be the name of the product.

While we can't say this confirms Apple's plans, well-connected tipster Mark Gurman posted on X today: "Internally, everyone calls it the Ultra."

"Ultra" is a name commonly used by many Apple employees, but that doesn't mean it's the final branding.

Apple is known for its secrecy, so many employees usually don't know about unannounced products unless they're directly involved in related work.

The internal use of "iPhone Ultra" might simply be because the outside world has been calling the foldable device the Ultra. In reality, likely only core members of Apple's marketing team and other informed employees know the actual naming plans for the product.

What do you think — will the iPhone Ultra be the name of the foldable? What other names might have a better chance? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
